subject: Re: Approval needed: ProtoForge AI annual subscription
body:
Subject: Re: Approval needed: ProtoForge AI annual subscription

Hi Devon,

I'm not able to auto-approve the $20,000 annual subscription for ProtoForge AI as per our preference. The spend figure is $20,000, which is above the threshold of $5,000 that requires manual approval.

I'll escalate this to Priya Shah, our CFO, for further review and approval. Please let me know if you need any additional information from me.

Best,
Alex
